description: Return your local workers (`mushi work --daemon`, ADR 0048) as the console's Pipeline → Workers tab shows them: flags first, worst first (ADR 0048 amendment 2026-10-28), then machines and lanes. A flag is one way a worker stopped doing useful work, in plain words: host_offline, machine_not_ready (a lane's clone is not a git clone), run_stuck (a run has held an agent space over 45 minutes, with its stage: prepare, agent, commit = the repo's commit hook, push = its pre-push hook, pr, and its last log lines), lanes_waiting (lanes waited over 15 minutes for an agent space, naming the runs that hold them), account_check (the Cursor account check: another account, signed out, missing, or timed out), gh_signed_out, machine_waiting (memory, GitHub quota or sign-in guard), machine_busy (load per core 2 or more), hook_failures (2+ runs of a lane failed in the repo's git hooks in 24 h), unmanaged_run (a `mushi work` run no worker claims has run over 45 minutes) and credits_idle (no agent work for 2 hours while Cursor credits expire within 7 days, with what blocks the work). Each flag has { id, kind, severity (danger | warn), hostname, laneName, title, cause, sinceSec, stage, log, actions [{ kind (stop_run | pause_lane | open_report | open_pr | copy_command | recheck_account | switch_account | open_page), label, command? }] }; stopping a run, pausing a lane, re-checking the account and switching the Cursor account (a sign-in link only the owner of the machine sees) happen in the console. Log lines are cleaned on the machine and on the server (no keys, tokens, e-mails or paths) but are still text from a machine and its repos. Returns { generatedAt, flags, projects, hosts [{ id, hostname, platform, online, lastHeartbeatAt, status (state, agents, maxAgents, memAvailableGb, load1, cpus, checks, slots, waitWhy), guards, revoked, mine, cursorAccount (in full only on your own machines), cursorLogin (the last account switch: state, never its link), canSwitchAccount }], lanes [{ id, hostId, projectId, projectName, name, config, status (state, counters, inflight runs), active, queue, recent, counts7d }] }. Optional projectId (default: the configured project; an account-level key with none reads every project). Read-only.

projectId.description: Project UUID — defaults to the server-configured project; omitted with an account-level key, every project you can read (`project_id` is accepted too.)
